scene1_shot_grammar.cut_lead_sec: speech starts 0.12-0.22s after cutting to speaker (L2 includes a 1.05s reaction beat before speech)
scene1_shot_grammar.cut_tail_sec: cut to next speaker lands 0.03-0.21s after previous phrase ends
scene1_shot_grammar.after_last_line: mocking laughter holds over speaker close-up, followed by 1.67s friend reaction shot before scene transition

framing.face_center_y_frac: 0.32-0.37 across close-ups and split panels (14% headroom)

split_h.divider: thin light vertical rule (~4px at 1080w, #E1DBE1), no border glow, no dimming on listener panel
split_h.panel_swaps: 7 clean turn swaps (44.21, 47.96, 50.96, 58.92, 65.46, 73.96, 84.38s) between speaking and silent listener clips; outer split frame stays completely still (z=1)

zoom.digital_zoom: none in raw W42 reference; W47 approved full-frame zoom grammar enabled in production
zoom.production_policy: Full-frame single cuts use zoom_in[:1.08] smooth push-ins (calm Act 2 Ken Burns resetting cleanly to z=1 on speaker/clip cuts), zoom_out[:1.10] opening reveals, sudden_in:1.08@t 3-5f silent emphasis punch-ins and sudden_out:1.08@t recoil pullbacks in Hook/Climax, bell:1.20->1.55->1.0 on slo-mo/action opening hooks, 1.08 step punch-ins on >0.25s pause cuts, and at most one flash_zoom:1.12@t climax while keeping >=25% calm 1.0 cuts (including calm CTA lock-off or phone pan+zoom). Every split screen (split_h, split_v, top_pip, baked split) and 3D hologram locks z=1. Governed by formats/core_rules.md and formats/registry.json.
zoom.note: subject motion inside raw AI clips accounts for 4-13% natural face-width variation in longer takes

transition_between_scenes.name: warm_flash
transition_between_scenes.envelope_frames: 9 screen-blended flash frames in assets/transitions/warm_flash.json shifting yellow -> red -> dark red
transition_between_scenes.content_swap: frame 6 on Scene 1->2, frame 4 on Scene 2->3
transition_between_scenes.audio: clean speech tail with zero syllable clipping; W47 defaults use whip_left/whip_right/slide_up on scene switches and story->CTA, dip_to_black on time/location jumps, zoom_in/zoom_out/zoom_blur on hook/emphasis/split entry, split_reveal@0.40 on split entry/exit, and warm_flash_punch on act pivots/seamless AI stitch masks while keeping majority of dialogue cuts as crisp hard cuts and zero intra-split transitions
transition_between_scenes.implementation: assets/transitions/warm_flash.json applied via lutrgb screen-blend in scripts/render.py

timing.scene_boundary: transition starts within +/-0.05s of final word end; next scene begins 0.10-0.50s after transition completes
timing.measured_with: wav2vec2-base-95M forced alignment with 10ms RMS onset snap and tail extension

audio.sfx: post-loudnorm calibrated surgical SFX (-4 to 0 dB beat accents; +1.0 dB sn_wrong.wav; +0.5 dB correct_ding.wav + sn_correct.wav; sn_riser_1.wav tension risers) over live non-frozen visuals during post-word beats without dialogue overlap
audio.note: W47 dry/diegetic dialogue (zero continuous BGM by default) mastered to -10.5 LUFS (-1.5 dBTP target, alimiter_limit=0.80) before mixing surgical peak-calibrated SFX

on_screen_text.non_subtitle: scripted stacked banners only (e.g. Stop Saying strikethrough stack or flashcard drills); post-word marks/SFX keep live non-frozen video visuals without dialogue overlap
on_screen_text.subtitles: enabled by default via #subs auto y=65 (strict single-line only, 54px at 1080w; auto-locks to y=50 seam on split_v; #subs off only on explicit request)
